solutions.title: Memoized target search
solutions.strategy: Search include/exclude choices for target half-sum while memoizing index and remaining sum.

timeComplexity.explanation: There are n indices and S possible remaining sums up to the target.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The memo table stores reachable index/remaining states.

solutions.title: One-dimensional subset DP
solutions.strategy: Track which subset sums up to target are reachable, updating backward for each number.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each number scans sums up to the target S.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The reachable table stores one boolean per target sum.
